scope: Complete pinned owned source; two returned Git blobs reconciled to full recursive Git inventory, root MIT/NOTICE inspected. Selected external-to-package references checked for existence only.

license.obligation: Preserve complete MIT notice for eligible original expression; third-party book text, translations, audio and model/asset rights are separate.

material_findings.finding: The entrypoint reports tested two-voice support and says the dialect is known; its appendix and companion reference still classify dialect and multi-voice support as unconfirmed. No backend version, exact fixture or reproducibility receipt is supplied. Require a versioned capability probe and conservative fallback.

Identical symbolic input alone does not establish identical audio or isolate a single variable. Renderer, soundfont, plugins, timing resolution, settings and environment must also be pinned; no emitter executable is owned by this two-file package. The described author experiment is not an independent host test.

Raw title, motif ABC and lyrics insertion, and wholesale export of intent/mix/vocal text into comments or metadata, lack escaping, field allowlists and privacy controls. Embedded line breaks or target-format delimiters can alter output structure; internal notes may be carried into shared files. Require format-aware serialization, validated motifs, minimization and separately approved destinations.

Aggregate bar count and chord-degree checks do not establish per-voice measure durations, note/lyric alignment, effective accidentals, supported target features or lossless conversion. The source acknowledges that the named parser drops lyric lines and chord playback. Require per-format semantic round-trip and explicit loss reporting.

Neighboring schema, backend configuration, render and orchestration skills and external parsers/synths are dependencies. Their presence is not authorization to execute, upload lyrics, install software, spend credits or distribute protected material. Preserve MIT notice for original content; model weights and protected material have separate rights.

positive_safeguards: Explicit format capability differences and pre-synthesis checks.
Acknowledges parser lyric loss, chord playback gaps and unresolved melody-density experiment.
records.remediation: Version and test backend capability, pin renderer dependencies, serialize and minimize metadata, require per-voice and per-target semantic checks, separate external execution and publication authorization.

historical_scan.interpretation: Historical reference_missing count preserved. Selected sibling references exist outside owned tree; not all 16 scanner locations independently resolved. No scanner rerun.
